/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json, re, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path
j=json.loads(Path('out/skills-gap.json').read_text())
s=ET.parse('out/skills-gap-card.svg').getroot()
assert s.attrib['width']=='1200' and s.attrib['height']=='630'
assert len(j['categories'])==6 and len(j['recommended_skills'])<=7
for c in j['categories']:
 assert (c['rating']=='Not measured')==(c['relevant_entries']<2)
raw='\\n'.join(p.read_text() for p in Path('out').iterdir())
source=Path('prompts.txt').read_text()
for line in source.splitlines():
 if line.strip(): assert line not in raw
private=re.findall(r'Secret client:\\s*(["'^'"\\n.]+)',source)
assert all(name.lower() not in raw.lower() for name in private)
assert not any(x in raw for x in ['prompts.txt','skills-gap.json','skills-gap-card.svg','/Users/'])
print('PASS: JSON and SVG parse; dimensions, category thresholds, recommendation cap, and privacy checks verified.')
PY"

Created [JSON assessment](out/skills-gap.json) and [1200 × 630 share card](out/skills-gap-card.svg). Privacy and structural checks passed.

Spreadsheet work rates Critical; Writing is provisionally strongest, rated Developing. Other categories are Not measured.

Results describe the supplied sample, not the model’s intelligence. Recommendations are relevant skills, not confirmed missing installations.
